events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: A True Showman
angles.copy: A true showman and a voice that transcended generations, we remember the incredible legacy of Freddie Mercury today.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Still Sounds Fresh
angles.copy: Fifty-one years on, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' still sounds as fresh and innovative as the day it dropped.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world lost music legend John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: His Music Resonates
angles.copy: His music and message continue to resonate globally; we pay tribute to the incomparable John Lennon today.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Music icon David Bowie, born in 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: The Starman's 80th
angles.copy: The Starman himself, David Bowie, would have been 80 today – a true innovator whose influence is still felt across music and culture.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, born in 1935, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today, and his legendary sound still gets us all shook up.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page, born in 1944, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Riffs For Days
angles.copy: Sending a very happy 83rd birthday to the one and only Jimmy Page – his riffs shaped rock history.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Rod Stewart, born in 1945, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: From Faces to solo superstardom, happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Rod Stewart.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson), born in 1961, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Our House Of Fun
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the iconic voice of Madness, still bringing the house down.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, born in 1956, known for hits like "Wherever I Lay My Hat," celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Wherever He Lays His Hat
angles.copy: Wherever he lays his hat, that's his home for a birthday celebration! Happy 71st to the brilliant Paul Young.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, born in 1946, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen Of Country
angles.copy: From humble beginnings to global icon, wishing a very happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and singer-songwriter Gary Barlow, born in 1971, celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Still Going Strong
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's Gary Barlow – still going strong after all these years.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, born in 1950, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Get out your dancing shoes, it's Billy Ocean's 77th birthday! He'll be feeling 'Caribbean Queen' today.

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Inaugural Ceremony
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony, honouring legends like Elvis Presley and Chuck Berry, took place on this day in 1989.

angles.name: Cementing Legends
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock royalty gathered for the first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction – a night that cemented legends.

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, born in 1972, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Still Bringing The Charm
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen – still bringing the charm.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their iconic final live performance, the rooftop concert, on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Historic Rooftop Gig
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles played their legendary rooftop concert – a historic moment in music that still gives us chills.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis drummer and hugely successful solo artist Phil Collins, born in 1951, celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Another Drum Fill
angles.copy: Another year, another drum fill! Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: British actor Hugh Grant, born in 1960, known for his roles in romantic comedies, celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Quintessential British Actor
angles.copy: From floppy hair to political drama, wishing a very happy 67th birthday to the quintessential British actor, Hugh Grant.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake, born in 1981, celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Bringing Sexy Back For 46
angles.copy: He's brought sexy back for 46 years! Happy birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, born in 1940, famous for his roles as Del Boy and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly!
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason.

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: On this tragic day in 1959, Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper died in a plane crash, forever known as "The Day The Music Died."

angles.name: Remembering Lost Legends
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago, music lost three incredible talents in one devastating moment – we remember Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Pop icon Rick Astley, born in 1966, famous for "Never Gonna Give You Up," celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give Up Celebrating
angles.copy: He's never gonna give up on celebrating! Happy 61st birthday to the legendary Rick Astley.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley, born in 1945, would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love, One Legend
angles.copy: One love, one heart, one legend. Bob Marley would have been 82 today, and his music continues to inspire.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Influential singer-songwriter Carole King, born in 1942, known for "Tapestry," celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Songwriting Powerhouse
angles.copy: A true songwriting powerhouse, happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: The world remembers the incomparable voice of Whitney Houston, who passed away on this day in 2012, at the age of 48.

angles.name: Voice Of A Generation
angles.copy: Her voice was pure magic. We remember the incredible talent and legacy of Whitney Houston today.

events.title: Take That's Original Split Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, pop phenomenon Take That announced their initial split, devastating fans worldwide.

angles.name: The Day The Pop World Wept
angles.copy: Twenty-one years ago, the pop world wept as Take That announced their split – thankfully, they found their way back to us!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell, born in 1959, celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Red, Red Wine & Birthday
angles.copy: Red, Red Wine and a happy 68th birthday to UB40's Ali Campbell!

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran, born in 1991, celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Perfectly 36
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran – still making us fall 'Perfect'ly in love with his music.

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: The quiet Beatle, George Harrison, born in 1943, would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering The Quiet Beatle
angles.copy: We remember the incredible talent of George Harrison, who would have been 84 today – a true musical legend.
